cameras.capture: Existing walk setPose + deterministic production pointer drag; no bundle patch

runtimeLights.name: R1 window sky approximation
runtimeLights.purpose: Existing realtime approximation, not a measured luminaire or baked indirect solution

emissive.runtimeNote: Visible emissive surface; standard Three rendering does not cast area illumination from it
emissive.localBlendDefault: Excluded from render for initial daylight study; geometry/material retained in separate collection

glass.runtimeOnly: One polished-pane r170 base-LOD transmission sampling hook is not portable to GLB/Blender
glass.bakeDecision: Planner must test glass transmission/shadow rays; do not replace panes with opaque blockers or bake a lightmap onto the glass

treeShadowReference.runtimeShadow: Cached sun/local shadow includes it; no wind animation. Runtime far LOD is not the preparation geometry

localBlendLighting: No world or lights intentionally. Geometry preparation only; select material preview to inspect. Planner supplies an actual calibrated lighting rig using these references. Blender inspection lights in the old full blend were not the runtime lighting rig.
